title: Scheduler next-start search is expensive with many long tasks
description:
When nothing is eligible, select_task() calls indigo_scheduler_next_eligible() for every task, which checks the whole duration at every 5-minute candidate: about 577 x duration points x tasks, up to ~21M point checks for 128 tasks of 24 h, on the handler queue every IDLE_CHECK_INTERVAL. Next: precompute per-task point validity and use a sliding window, and add the planned 128-task performance test (phase 3).
